sceneLabel: 3D playground. Click to control your character.
unsupported: This browser could not open the 3D world (WebGL is off or unavailable). You are still in the call and hear everyone as usual.

hint.desktop: Click or drag the scene to look around · WASD or arrows · Shift runs · Space jumps · V switches camera · Esc frees the mouse
hint.touch: Drag on the left to walk and on the right to look around

screen.idleHint: Share your screen for everyone to watch here
screen.taken: Someone else is already on the big screen. Wait until they stop sharing to stream.
